commands.help.create: Continue the active character's staged creation flow.
commands.creation.no_character: Create or select a character before continuing character creation.
commands.creation.unsupported: This character's rule system does not expose a staged creation flow.
commands.creation.not_started: This character does not have an active staged creation flow.
commands.creation.choice_free: · {id}: enter a specialization as free text
commands.creation.layer_browse: Use `.{command} <option>` to inspect that option's required choices.
commands.creation.fixed_apply: Use `.{command} apply` to apply this already selected stage.
commands.creation.invalid: That creation choice cannot be applied now. Check the current stage, option, and every required choice.
commands.creation.save_failed: The creation change was not saved, so it is not treated as applied.
commands.creation.duplicates: Replace {count} duplicate value(s) in {field}. Allowed replacements: {choices}
commands.creation.duplicates_usage: Use `.{command} {assignments}`. Separate multiple replacements for one field with `;`.
commands.creation.advancement_usage: Use `.advance` to review or buy advancements. When finished, use `.{command} done` to continue creation; unspent XP is preserved.
commands.creation.advancement_done: Creation advancement stage finished with unspent XP preserved.
commands.creation.equipment: Starting acquisitions: {remaining} remaining of {total}. Available items: {items}
commands.creation.equipment_usage: Use `.{command} <item>` to take one starting acquisition.
